scope: Synthetic-trained GraphPFN with confidence-weighted sheaf PCFI; real graphs frozen; no heterogeneous graphs
real_feature_projection: Fixed seed Rademacher RP16 applied to observed full rows only; no data-fitted PCA or hidden-value scaling. Observed-only compressed RMS normalization. Native-PCFI-then-same-RP is an extra strong input baseline on pcfi100 checkpoint.
generator: Balanced labels, label-based SBM with diagonal preference6 (homo) or .15 (hetero), expected degree8. Independent feature-law lambda=+.65 or -.65 in X=(I-lambda*P)^(-1)(classmean+.35noise), random feature signs/scales; record achieved label agreement/feature energy. No rejection based on achieved accuracy/homophily. These are known synthetic families, not unseen semantic schemas.
training: Same public GraphPFN1.3/LimiX initialization and existing frozen-transformer/trainable-adapter policy; same task schedule and384successful CE updates/arm/seed. No real-data updates, validation-based selection, auxiliary loss, or post-test rescue. Query CE only; input contains context labels only.
propagation: alpha=.9; warm100 ordinary confidence spatial steps shared as router evidence; learned/pcfi200 start from warm and run100further steps, then one original inter-channel correlation correction. pcfi100 uses warm+onecorrection. Every step clamps observed values. Sheaf lifts each scalar to[x,0], uses symmetric contraction T=(1-gamma)I+gamma*Q(theta), Q=[[cos,sin],[sin,-cos]], then reads first coordinate. Signed uses same first-coordinate coefficient as scalar, weighted uses T=I. Same3output shared MLP on symmetric observed/context/structure descriptors. Self loops T=I.
synthetic_primary: Missing-query accuracy, graph-average over4node-missing cases and3fixedtrainingseeds; new32basegraphs paired bootstrap5000. Sheaf must beat pcfi100,pcfi200,weighted,signed with lowerCI>0; homo harm guard -2pp.
real_primary: Four dataset means reported separately; within dataset average4missingconditions,3mask/contextrepetitions,3fixedtrainingseeds. Missing-feature non-context query accuracy; macro-F1,NLL,Brier separate. Heterophily mean must improve over pcfi100 and signed, while homo drop<=2pp. Four selected graphs are a development pilot, not population-level independent real-graph proof. No node-bootstrap significance.
real_context: Select at most4 labeled nodes per class from existing official training masks only; all other labels withheld. Real test set uses existing test masks. No validation labels inspected or used. For WebKB use first3provided splits; Planetoid public train/test reused with fresh context/mask draws.
missing: Uniform whole-node masks Bernoulli; cluster masks fixed-count BFS-nearest observed source regions;90/99.5percent. Zero-source episodes retained; actual counts and rounding reported. Full-feature reference is separate.
controls: Feature removal and shuffle keep original missing-query sets; no-feature control diagnoses graph/context contribution. Reconstruction errors evaluated against hidden raw values only after predictions. Native real-feature PCFI baseline retained to expose projection artifacts. Report all training and inference costs.
limits: Pilot of one2D symmetric-contraction sheaf subfamily,16RPfeatures,128node synthetic generator,384updates; not original NSD reproduction or proof of universal PFN superiority. Label heterophily and feature roughness are different and measured separately.
